exposure: Prenatal exposure to prescription opioids (overall, by trimester, for pain or opioid use disorder [OUD])
outcome: Hospital admissions and emergency department presentations for immune-related conditions (infections, asthma, eczema and dermatitis, allergy and anaphylaxis, autoimmune diseases)
cohort: All children born in Western Australia between January 1, 2003, and December 31, 2018, whose linked administrative health records were analyzed.
finding: Prenatal opioid exposure was associated with an increased risk of infection, eczema and dermatitis, and asthma in children, but not allergies and anaphylaxis or autoimmune conditions.
followup_time: Up to 5 years of age for outcomes, or until June 30, 2020, whichever came first.
